system:
You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

response: {"headline": "The STRENGTH trial of omega-3 carboxylic acids (Epanova) was stopped early for futility in January 2020 after an independent data monitoring committee concluded the drug was unlikely to show cardiovascular benefit.","summary": "STRENGTH randomized approximately 13,086 statin-treated patients with triglycerides 175–499 mg/dL to Epanova 4 g/day or corn oil placebo, targeting a broad MACE composite including coronary revascularization and hospitalization for unstable angina. The trial planned 1,600 events over a median 3-year follow-up but was halted before reaching that threshold. The calculator could not predict an outcome because no placebo-adjusted triglyceride change was measured in the phase 3 population — only within-arm phase 2 reductions of –26% to –31% — leaving the expected effect size unknown. The primary reason for failure is classified as insufficient data, with design choices (corn oil placebo, soft endpoints) and uncertainty about whether triglyceride lowering per se is causal as contributing factors. Confidence in this assessment is medium.","key_evidence": ["~13,086 patients randomized (Assessment of omega-3 carboxylic acids in statin-treated patients with high levels of triglycerides and low levels of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol: Rationale and design of the STRENGTH trial; Update on Phase III STRENGTH trial for Epanova in mixed dyslipidaemia)", "Inclusion required triglycerides 175–499 mg/dL (Update on Phase III STRENGTH trial for Epanova in mixed dyslipidaemia)", "Primary endpoint: time to first CV death, MI, stroke, coronary revascularization, or hospitalization for unstable angina (Assessment of omega-3 carboxylic acids in statin-treated patients with high levels of triglycerides and low levels of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol: Rationale and design of the STRENGTH trial)", "Planned 1,600 primary endpoint events (Assessment of omega-3 carboxylic acids in statin-treated patients with high levels of triglycerides and low levels of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol: Rationale and design of the STRENGTH trial)", "Median follow-up 3 years (Assessment of omega-3 carboxylic acids in statin-treated patients with high levels of triglycerides and low levels of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol: Rationale and design of the STRENGTH trial)", "No placebo-adjusted triglyceride change measured; only within-arm phase 2 reductions of –26% (Effects of free omega-3 carboxylic acids and fenofibrate on liver fat content in patients with hypertriglyceridemia and non-alcoholic fatty liver disease) and –31% (Assessment of omega-3 carboxylic acids in statin-treated patients with high levels of triglycerides and low levels of high-density lipoprotein cholesterol: Rationale and design of the STRENGTH trial)", "Trial stopped early for futility per IDMC recommendation (Update on Phase III STRENGTH trial for Epanova in mixed dyslipidaemia)", "Calculator MDE HR 0.869 at 80% power; category insufficient_data, weakest link: triglycerides change not measured (calculator)"],"what_would_change_this": "A placebo-adjusted triglyceride or apoB change from a phase 3 trial of Epanova 4 g/day in the STRENGTH population would allow the calculator to estimate expected benefit. Final STRENGTH results with hazard ratio and confidence interval would clarify whether the corn oil placebo or endpoint composition contributed to the null result.","readthrough_note": "REDUCE-IT used pure EPA (icosapent ethyl) and showed benefit in a similar population, but STRENGTH tested EPA+DHA carboxylic acids with a corn oil placebo; the different formulation and placebo choice limit direct read-through to other omega-3 programmes."}
